id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Multi-drop linear bus (daisy-chain) over a shared RS-485 differential pair with active termination at both segment ends; repeaters extend reach and station count. PROFIBUS-PA adds a trunk-and-spur / tree MBP topology bridged to the DP backbone. There is no point-to-point serial fabric — all stations share one bus.

supported_topologies.name: Linear bus segment
supported_topologies.description: Up to 32 stations on a terminated RS-485 segment.

supported_topologies.name: Repeated network
supported_topologies.description: Repeaters join segments to reach up to 126 addressable stations.

supported_topologies.name: Multi-master
supported_topologies.description: Several masters share the bus via token passing.

supported_topologies.name: DP backbone + PA segments
supported_topologies.description: DP/PA couplers or links bridge 31.25 kbit/s PA (MBP) segments onto the DP backbone.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Runs the cyclic I/O data exchange with its assigned slaves (e.g. a PLC).
Engineering / diagnostic / configuration device; master-to-master services.
Passive station; responds only when polled (remote I/O, drive, sensor).
Regenerates the RS-485 signal and counts as a station load.
Bridges a PA (MBP) segment to the DP backbone.

fields.interconnect_role: PROFIBUS is a shared-medium fieldbus. Active masters arbitrate the bus by passing a token in a logical ring; the token holder polls its passive slaves in a master-slave manner. Stations are addressed 0..126 and selected by Destination Address + Service Access Point. PA segments are bridged to the DP backbone.

ordering_guarantees.token: Exactly one master holds the token and transmits at a time (deterministic, bounded by TTR).
ordering_guarantees.poll: A master polls its slaves in a defined cyclic order each bus cycle.
ordering_guarantees.broadcast: Global_Control SYNC/FREEZE reaches a slave group simultaneously.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: PROFIBUS is not memory-mapped; stations and services are addressed by station address (DA/SA) and Service Access Point (DSAP/SSAP), and DPV1 data records by Slot and Index — not by a memory or peripheral address.

device_classification.dpm1: DP Class-1 master: cyclic I/O data exchange.
device_classification.dp_pa_coupler: Bridges a PA (MBP) segment to the DP backbone.
